name: Proton CEO wanted to check who uses AI
ig:
The CEO of Proton wanted to check who at the company uses AI. His employees were scared.
He planned to call almost every employee in for a talk about it. According to 404 Media, they feared being fired if it turned out they used it too little. After the story came out, he canceled the talks, but said he still wants employees to use AI more. No more talks, but the pressure stays.
Should companies require employees to use AI? Tell me in the comments.
#אבאאיציק #AI #Proton
Source: 404 Media, 2026
